messages:
lisa_support: FYI ACME just escalated — after the canary swap their structured output started dropping `order_id` and coercing `price` to null in some responses. They attached a minimal repro. cc @ingrid_eng @jamal_runtime

ingrid_eng: can you paste the exact request + model param? also tenant id and a sample request id so we can grep logs

lisa_support: tenant acme-inc, req_id 0a3f7b2e. They hit `/v1/generate` with model `redwood-llm-canary:v6m-q8` (we rolled this canary last night). Sample request:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-llm-canary:v6m-q8","input":"generate order json","structured_output":true}'```

matt_support: pasting the customer response payload they sent — note `order_id` missing and `price` is null:```{ "customer": "ACME", "items": [{"sku":"X12"}], "price": null }``` They said previous model (v6m) returned:```{ "customer":"ACME","order_id":"ORD-123","items":[{"sku":"X12"}],"price": 199.99 }```

jamal_runtime: saw the canary rollout logs. Deploy name `canary-2026-02-18-quantize` flipped at 02:14 UTC. There was a kernel change for quantized attention and a small KV-cache trim optimization. Noted a warning in the runtime logs about "kv_prefix_trim mismatch" for a subset of shapes.

alexa_sre: grep shows the request id across two hosts: host-a returned the older variant (with order_id), host-b ran the new canary and returned the trimmed response. So it's likely a serving/runtime mismatch rather than the model weights themselves.

ingrid_eng: interesting — structured output mode applies a post-process that maps tokens to structured fields using soft delimiters. If prefix/KV caching changes token alignments, that could drop optional top-level fields when the model emits them in a slightly different tokenization boundary.

jamal_runtime: repro steps I ran (local): 1) pin model to `redwood-llm-stable:v6m` -> structured output OK. 2) switch to `redwood-llm-canary:v6m-q8` -> intermittent omission of `order_id` and `price` nulls. Script:```for i in {1..30}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-llm-canary:v6m-q8","input":"generate order json","structured_output":true}' | jq '.'; done```

lisa_support: customer asked for a workaround — can we recommend pinning to stable? also they want an ETA for fix

jamal_runtime: short term: pin to `redwood-llm-stable:v6m` or set the request header `X-Serve-Prefer: deterministic-tokenization=true` (this forces a legacy tokenization path we keep for compatibility). Both validated as immediate workarounds for ACME.

ingrid_eng: longer term: need to ensure canary quantize kernels preserve token boundaries used by structured-output postprocessor. I'll open a ticket to add a unit test that runs structured-output prompts through any new kernel/kv change.

alexa_sre: I'll rollback the canary on the fraction of hosts that still have it (host-b). Rolling back those pods now. ops-bot will post when completed.

ops-bot: Deployment rollback triggered: revert canary-2026-02-18-quantize -> in_progress

ops-bot: Deployment rollback completed: revert canary-2026-02-18-quantize -> success (02:48 UTC)

sophie_acme: Confirming — after pinning to `redwood-llm-stable:v6m` our webhook returned the full object again. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

matt_support: leaving a note in the ticket for billing/credits (they had retries). Also adding customer-facing blurb with workaround steps for pinning or header.

ingrid_eng: next actions: (1) reproduce in CI with structured-output test matrix + quantized kernels (2) add regression alert for structured-output field omissions on canary (3) follow up with postmortem and timeline. I'll write up a short postmortem draft and tag teams.

lisa_support: created support ticket #SUP-2026-452 and linked to internal issue RTL-1789. I'll update ACME with the rollback and the workaround options.

jamal_runtime: note for runbook — if you see `kv_prefix_trim mismatch` warnings correlated with structured-output regressions, rollback canary and pin to stable immediately; we'll prioritize a fix for the quantize kernel.

matt_support: thanks everyone. I'll confirm credits and close the support loop once ACME acknowledges. :white_check_mark:
